- C1: symptoms usually develop over months to years. This supports a months-long history, but not specifically half-year. "months to years" could be 6 months? Maybe half-year is within months. But "usually develop over months to years" means progression, not necessarily prior pain duration. Could establish "history of pain for half a year" if pain began months ago? Not exact.
